selection_rules.sampling: current_hybrid unless another policy improves baseline-dev macro F0.5 by at least 0.001; ties use fewer negatives
selection_rules.features: all_v1 unless an ablation improves macro F0.5 by at least 0.002 without reducing either country macro by >0.01
selection_rules.training_tier: smallest tier within 0.001 macro F0.5 of the best nested tier
selection_rules.configuration: highest model-tune macro F0.5, then fewer leaves, then fewer rounds
